My academic leadership spans **editorial work, national research governance, funding and peer review, NHS research infrastructure, and research culture**. These roles reflect increasing external responsibility for academic judgement, research quality, access to sensitive data, and the development of research environments.

## Editorial and scholarly leadership

- **Associate Editor**, [*Addiction*](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/13600443/homepage/editorialboard.html)
- **Editorial Board Member**, [*Substance Use: Research and Treatment*](https://journals.sagepub.com/editorial-board/SAT)

## National advisory and governance roles

- **Expert Member**, [Confidentiality Advisory Group, Health Research Authority](https://www.hra.nhs.uk/about-us/committees-and-services/confidentiality-advisory-group/)
- **Steering Committee Member**, [Addiction Healthcare Goals](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/life-sciences-healthcare-goals/addiction-healthcare-goals)
- **Steering Group Member**, [NIHR Mental Health Research (MHR) Incubator](https://mentalhealthresearch.org.uk/)
- **Data Access Committee Public Member**, [Eastern England Secure Data Environment](https://easternsde.nhs.uk/)
- **Task & Finish Group Member**, [Administrative Data Research UK](https://www.adruk.org/)

These roles involve contributing independent academic, methodological, governance, and public-interest perspectives to decisions about research priorities, access to sensitive data, and the development of health research.

## Research assessment and peer review

- **Assessor College**, [Economic and Social Research Council](https://www.ukri.org/councils/esrc/)
- **Expert Assessor**, [Administrative Data Research UK](https://www.adruk.org/)
- **Reviewer College**, [Society for the Study of Addiction](https://www.addiction-ssa.org/)
- **Expert Reviewer**, [Eating Disorders Clinical Research Network](https://www.kcl.ac.uk/research/eating-disorders-clinical-research-network)

I also regularly review manuscripts for journals across psychiatry, epidemiology, substance use, public health, and health-services research.

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(rcrossref)

orcid_id <- "0000-0003-2881-4906"

resp <- request(
  paste0(
    "https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/",
    orcid_id,
    "/peer-reviews"
  )
) |>
  req_headers(Accept = "application/json") |>
  req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) |>
  req_perform()

if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {

  body <- resp_body_json(resp)

  raw <- map_chr(body$group, \(g) {
    val <- tryCatch(
      g$`external-ids`$`external-id`[[1]]$`external-id-value`,
      error = \(e) NA_character_
    )

    if (is.null(val)) NA_character_ else val
  })

  issns_clean <- raw[
    !is.na(raw) &
      str_starts(raw, "issn:")
  ] |>
    str_remove("^issn:") |>
    unique()

  get_title_from_issn <- function(issn) {
    tryCatch({
      result <- rcrossref::cr_journals(issn)$data$title
      if (is.null(result) || length(result) == 0) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }
      result[[1]]
    }, error = \(e) NA_character_)
  }

  journal_names <- map_chr(
    issns_clean,
    get_title_from_issn
  ) |>
    (\(x) x[!is.na(x)])() |>
    unique() |>
    str_squish() |>
    str_replace("Men s", "Men's") |>
    (\(x) x[
      order(
        str_remove(
          x,
          regex(
            "^(the|a|an)\\s+",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        )
      )
    ])()

  if (length(journal_names) > 0) {
    cat(
      "<details>\n",
      "<summary><b>Selected journals for which I have served as a peer reviewer</b></summary>\n\n",
      paste0("- ", journal_names, collapse = "\n"),
      "\n\n</details>\n"
    )
  }
}
```

## Research infrastructure and enabling leadership

- **Deputy Lead**, [North London NHS Foundation Trust Research Database](https://www.northlondonmentalhealth.nhs.uk/research-database-)

Through the Research Database, I help enable ethically governed research using routinely collected mental-health records. My work spans research development, data governance, methodological support, collaboration with NHS and academic researchers, and efforts to improve harmonisation and access across mental-health research data infrastructures.

I also work with colleagues at South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust to support harmonisation across CRIS sites, including approaches that make cross-site replication and comparative studies easier to undertake.

## Research culture and institutional leadership

At UCL, I contribute to initiatives aimed at improving research culture, equity, researcher development, and the experience of early-career colleagues.

- **Culture Change Action Group Lead**, Division of Psychiatry, UCL
- **LGBTQ+ Equity Action Group**, Division of Psychiatry, UCL
- **Committee Member**, Child and Young People's Mental Health ECR Network, UCL
